Perform a variable-cell relaxation (vc-relax) for BiFeO3 followed by a self-consistent field (SCF) calculation on the relaxed structure to obtain the final total energy.
Use the LDA pseudopotentials from the local files PseudoDojo/SR_v0.4.1/LDA_standard/bi.upf, PseudoDojo/SR_v0.4.1/LDA_standard/fe.upf, and PseudoDojo/SR_v0.4.1/LDA_standard/o.upf.
Build the starting structure from the case metadata: chemical formula BiFeO3, perovskite structure, space group R3c, with 10 atoms in the primitive cell; use standard R3c BiFeO3 rhombohedral lattice parameters and atomic positions consistent with this symmetry as the starting configuration.
Set etot_conv_thr = 1.0e-8.
Set forc_conv_thr = 1.0e-7.
Set conv_thr = 1.0e-8.
Use an automatic Monkhorst-Pack k-point grid with a half shift (shifted grid) in both the vc-relax and the SCF calculation.
Choose a converged ecutwfc value appropriate for the LDA pseudopotentials and the requested convergence thresholds.
Choose a sufficiently dense automatic k-point sampling grid appropriate for BiFeO3.
Use consistent settings (pseudopotentials, cutoffs, k-point grid, convergence thresholds) between the vc-relax and the subsequent SCF calculation.
After the vc-relax finishes, run the SCF calculation on the fully relaxed structure without further relaxation.
Return the fully relaxed structure, including lattice parameters and atomic positions, and the final SCF total energy.
